description: local>kanso-labs/.github:renovate-config is the organization's shared Renovate preset, and it is listed last because a later preset wins a conflict with an earlier one. This file is merged over config.js rather than inheriting from it, and config:recommended reinstates whatever config.js disabled, so extending the shared preset here is what actually carries an organization-wide setting into this repository. The extends array is therefore ordered by precedence rather than by name, unlike the keys around it. Nothing else is left in this file: the automerge rule it used to state in full now comes from the preset, which every managed repository extends, so restating it here would only be a copy that can drift.
